'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The [[Kanlaon]] volcano in central [[Philippines]] erupts, causing evacuations and a suspension of activities in the city of [[Canlaon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippine-officials-order-evacuation-urge-caution-after-volcano-eruption-2024-06-04/ (Reuters)]
'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 NEET controversy]]
** A controversy erupts due to the sudden declaration of the [[National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Undergraduate)|NEET-UG]] results 10 days earlier than the originally scheduled date amid allegations of irregularities and paper leaks.[https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/education/news/grace-marks-controversy-parents-terms-a-scam-in-neet-ug-results-lodge-complaint-with-officials-demanded-relief-for-affected-students/articleshow/110773495.cms (Times Of India)].
'''Politics and elections'''

*[[2024 Indian general election]]
**The alliance of parties led by [[Narendra Modi]] reaches the 272 seats threshold needed to form a government, but Modi's [[Bharatiya Janata Party|BJP party]] loses its outright parliamentary majority. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-asia-india-69072275 (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Nigerian general strike]]
**The [[Nigeria Labour Congress]] (NLC) and [[Trade Union Congress of Nigeria (2005)|Trade Union Congress]] (TUC) suspend the nationwide general strike, pending talks with the [[federal government of Nigeria]] about the raising of the country's minimum wage. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crggzg4x88go (BBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/nigeria-oil-workers-await-outcome-tuesdays-talks-before-quitting-oil-rigs-union-2024-06-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[International recognition of the State of Palestine]]
**[[Slovenia]]'s [[National Assembly (Slovenia)|parliament]] approves a motion to recognize a [[Palestinian state]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/slovenia-votes-to-recognize-palestinian-state/ (''The Times of Israel'')] 
*[[Mexico–United States border crisis]]
**[[US President]] [[Joe Biden]] enacts an [[executive order]] to temporarily suspend [[asylum seeker|asylum claims]] processing at the [[Mexico–United States border]] when the seven-day average of claims exceeds 2,500 per day. [[Amnesty International]] criticizes the executive order, accusing Biden of "setting a dangerous international precedent". [https://www.npr.org/2024/06/04/nx-s1-4991917/biden-executive-order-asylum-migration-border (NPR)] [https://apnews.com/article/biden-asylum-migration-immigration-mexico-border-dec5f83b468b5795479bf1f5e49799d5 (AP)]
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**The [[State Council of South Korea]] suspends the 2018 [[Panmunjom Declaration]] due to border tensions over balloons sent across the border by [[North Korea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/north-korea-south-korea-balloons-military-agreement-e98754a2d25b38cc501eefb46015cb98 (AP)]
*A local [[Mannheim]] politician is injured by a stabbing, five days after [[2024 Mannheim stabbing|the May 31 attack in the German city]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c877vynl2zgo (BBC)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese space program]]
**The [[China National Space Administration]]'s [[Chang'e 6]] [[spacecraft]] lifts off from the surface of the [[far side of the Moon]] carrying samples of [[lunar soil]] and [[moon rock|rocks]] back to [[Earth]]. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/space/chinas-change-6-probe-lifts-off-far-side-moon-2024-06-04/ (Reuters)]
*The [[National Health Service]] declares a "critical incident" after several hospitals in [[London]], including [[King's College Hospital]], say they have cancelled appointments and turned away patients after a [[cyberattack]] on their [[Synnovis]] IT systems. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-ransomware-networks-taken-down-ae4753ecb57d24f4f127270ed41ad934 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Major League Baseball season]]
**Venezuelan infielder [[Tucupita Marcano]] is [[List of people banned from Major League Baseball|permanently banned]] from [[Major League Baseball]] and [[Minor League Baseball]] for [[Sports betting|betting]] on [[Pittsburgh Pirates]] games while being a member of the team. [https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/news/mlb-gambling-scandal-padres-tucupita-marcano-banned-for-life-for-betting-on-baseball-games (CBS Sports)]
